guide.title: How to use Friend Teams
guide.description: Follow other teams to become friend teams and manage those relationships on this screen.

what.title: What are friend teams?
what.body: When two teams follow each other, they become friend teams. The list shows each team's established date and whether it is public or private. Results are paginated after 20 items.
what.note: Supporters and others only see friend teams that are set to public.

follow.title: Follow a team to become friends
follow.step1: Press the "Follow" button at the top of the Friend Teams tab
follow.step2: Search by team name and pick the team you want to follow. If you cannot find it, type the team's URL name (the last part of its address) directly
follow.step3: Enter a greeting message (optional, up to 300 characters)
follow.mutual: When the other team follows you back, "you are now friend teams" is displayed and the friend team relationship is established.
follow.caution_self: You cannot follow your own team
follow.caution_already: You cannot follow a team you already follow
follow.caution_busy: When the system is busy, it automatically retries up to 3 times. If it still fails, please wait a moment and try again
follow.caution_role: The "Follow" button is shown only to admins and deputy admins with permission

visibility.title: Switch between public and private
visibility.step1: Toggle the switch on the friend team's card
visibility.caution_admin: Only admins can do this. Everyone else sees the switch disabled
visibility.caution_revert: If the change fails, the switch returns to its previous state

unfollow.title: Unfollow a team
unfollow.step1: Press the "︙" on the right side of the friend team's card
unfollow.caution_kept: Posts that were forwarded in the past remain even after you unfollow
unfollow.caution_role: Only admins and deputy admins with permission can unfollow

related.title: Related screens
related.body: The following screens related to friend teams can be opened from the team menu.
related.item_folders: Friend folders — Organize friend teams into folders (you can create up to 20)
related.item_feed: Admin feed — Review posts from friend teams and forward them to your own team
related.item_exports: Reverse forwarding history — See which friends your team's posts were forwarded to
